title: Automatic drafts and clearer stack errors
introduction: Resume unfinished code after reloading and inspect stack errors more easily. Release screenshots are no longer included in offline saves, reducing storage use.
imageAlt: An instruction hover showing a missing String beside the instruction dictionary.

sections.title: Resume from your draft
sections.body: Newly created code and edits to examples are saved automatically in your browser and restored after reloading. Files and folders opened from outside the app are excluded.
sections.imageAlt: An edited example restored after reloading.

sections.title: See missing stack values while editing
sections.body: Editing an example now updates Problems and error markers without pressing Run. Instruction hovers show the types of missing values and when an instruction cannot execute.
sections.imageAlt: A hover showing the missing String argument for println.

sections.title: Follow control flow through stack errors
sections.body: When incoming stacks disagree at a branch merge, you can still inspect partially analyzed stacks. The graph shows control flow and explains the inconsistent merge in its diagnostics.
sections.imageAlt: Diagnostics and control flow for a loop with inconsistent stack heights.
